mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT wm.member_id FROM wx_member wm JOIN wecom_group_member wgm ON wm.wx_unionid = wgm.union_id WHERE wm.last_login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND wm.business_id = ${busId} AND wm.wx_unionid IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT wm.member_id FROM wx_member wm LEFT JOIN wecom_group_member wgm ON wm.wx_unionid = wgm.union_id and wgm.union_id is not null WHERE wm.last_login_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND wm.business_id = ${busId} AND wm.wx_unionid IS NOT NULL AND wgm.union_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wx_member_${key} SET community_flag = 1 AND member_category = 0

UPDATE wx_member_${key} SET community_flag = 2 WHERE wx_unionid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT union_id FROM wecom_group_member WHERE deleted = b'0' AND union_id IS NOT NULL) AND wx_unionid IS NOT NULL AND member_category = 0
